evals.prompt: Hi! I'm from Lahore, Pakistan and I just finished my BS Computer Science with a CGPA of 3.2/4.0. My IELTS is 6.5 overall. I want to do a Master's in Data Science or AI, starting Fall 2027. My family can support around $15,000 per year total (tuition + living), so I really need either cheap tuition or a scholarship. I'm open to any country in Europe or Asia. Which universities should I apply to?
evals.expected_output: A Reach/Match/Safety shortlist focused on low-tuition or scholarship-backed options (e.g. Germany, Finland waivers, Italy, Erasmus Mundus, Malaysia, Turkey/Korea scholarships) with a comparison table, funding section, next steps, and sources. Should not recommend schools that clearly exceed $15k/year without flagging scholarship dependency.
assertions: Groups universities into Reach, Match and Safety categories
Includes a comparison table with tuition, requirements and deadline columns
Includes a Sources section citing URLs or explicitly stating data is approximate and must be verified
Ends with concrete, numbered next steps
Every recommended option fits the ~$15k/yr budget, or the response explicitly says it depends on a scholarship
Names at least two specific fully or partly funded scholarships relevant to a Pakistani student (e.g. Erasmus Mundus, DAAD, GKS, MEXT, Türkiye Burslari, CSC)
Does not recommend Norway as a free-tuition option

evals.prompt: my daughter is in grade 12 in Toronto, she has a 91% average and wants to study nursing. we'd prefer she stays in Ontario or at most somewhere else in Canada. budget isn't a huge issue but she'd like a school with a good co-op or clinical placement program. what are good options and what are the deadlines?
evals.expected_output: Canadian nursing (BScN) programs classified Reach/Match/Safety for a 91% Ontario student, with OUAC deadlines, prerequisite courses (e.g. Grade 12 Bio, Chem, English, Math), clinical placement notes, domestic tuition, and next steps.
assertions: Groups universities into Reach, Match and Safety categories
Includes a comparison table with tuition, requirements and deadline columns
Includes a Sources section citing URLs or explicitly stating data is approximate and must be verified
Ends with concrete, numbered next steps
Mentions the OUAC application system and a January deadline
Lists Grade 12 prerequisite courses for nursing (e.g. Biology, Chemistry, English)
Addresses clinical placement / co-op quality, as the parent asked

evals.prompt: Should I go to TU Munich, University of Amsterdam, or KTH for a master's in mechanical engineering? I'm Indian, 8.4 CGPA from a tier-2 engineering college, GRE 318, no IELTS yet. Budget maybe 12-14 lakh INR per year.
evals.expected_output: A comparison of the three named universities for this profile (fees for non-EU, living costs converted to INR, requirements, deadlines, scholarships, admission odds), flagging that IELTS is needed, plus a few alternative Match/Safety suggestions since the budget is tight, and a clear recommendation.
assertions: Groups universities into Reach, Match and Safety categories
Includes a comparison table with tuition, requirements and deadline columns
Includes a Sources section citing URLs or explicitly stating data is approximate and must be verified
Ends with concrete, numbered next steps
Compares all three named universities (TUM, UvA, KTH) directly
Converts costs to INR
Flags that the student must take IELTS/TOEFL before applying
Notes that TUM now charges tuition to non-EU students
Gives a clear final recommendation
Points out that the University of Amsterdam has no mechanical engineering master's and suggests a Dutch technical university (TU Delft, TU Eindhoven or Twente) instead
